## When to use

Use this skill when the user asks about:
- Writing and running unit or integration tests with Vitest
- Mocking modules, functions, classes, timers, dates, globals, or network requests
- Configuring Vitest (`vitest.config.ts`, test options, environments)
- Code coverage setup and configuration
- Snapshot testing
- Browser mode and component testing
- TypeScript type-level testing
- Migrating from Jest or other test runners to Vitest
- Vitest CLI flags and programmatic API
